accept_criteria: Interviewer lines link to specific gap_evaluations or identified framing gaps
Questions are actionable VO pickup lines, not generic interview advice
Lines respect interviewer voice and do not put words in interviewee mouth
Empty interviewer_lines array is valid only when no VO pickups are required
reject_patterns: Weak or generic questions with no linkage to gap_evaluations
Questions that contradict content_brief thesis or coverage audit
Invented gaps not present in gap_evaluations artifact
Schema errors on gap_report required fields
